normal_hiking_response_note: Route-load, slower movement, higher heart-rate demand, pauses, and recovery needs can be normal hiking responses on a loaded uphill route. CH6.5.4 only marks relative within-group match-review context; it does not call normal load response abnormal.
interpretation_boundary: Descriptive CH6.5.4 personal route-load match review only. This layer compares each activity against the current activity-group reference ranges for route-load exposure, movement behavior, heart-rate context, and weather-behavior overlap. It is not an ability score, ability rank, ability class, THCI, radar, final hiking risk score, route suitability score, go/no-go decision, medical diagnosis, or causality evidence.
